title: Boomika
desc: An eager group of developers intends to renovate an abandoned property. However, unexpected interactions with the paranormal force them to rethink their decisions.

title: Venky Mama
desc: Venkatarathnam raises Karthik, his orphaned nephew, on his own after the death of his parents. Things change when Karthik suddenly leaves home without notice.

title: Chevaikalemai
desc: In a village, people are dying of strange circumstances which causes fear and chaos among villagers. A newly appointed police officer investigates and discovers absurd suspects.

title: Maan Karate
desc: During a trip, a group of four friends meet a person who forecasts their future by handing them a newspaper to be printed after four months. Later, they work hard to make his prediction come true.

title: Kodiyil Oruvan
desc: An ordinary IAS aspirant, who helps out many misguided youths in his locality and shares a close bond with his mother, takes on a huge challenge when he opposes a powerful miscreant.

title: Trigger
desc: An amateur set designer visits a dense forest to erect a set for an upcoming movie. However, he realises his mistake when he is informed of the growing tiger attacks in the forest.
